dre.ref_en: Listen, yeah. I been on this block my whole life, you get me? Nothing shocks me no more. Man just stays calm, innit.
dre.design: A young Black British man from South London, about 22, with a strong Multicultural London English roadman accent: glottal stops, 'th' said as 'f' or 'd', dropped h's. Deep, low, relaxed and unbothered, slow cool deadpan delivery, slightly husky.

lou.ref_en: Nah, bruv, I don't believe none of it. Every week it's a new story with you lot. Allow it, man, I'm tired, fam.
lou.design: A young British man from East London, about 20, with a heavy Multicultural London English roadman accent: glottal stops, 'th' as 'f', 'innit', 'bruv'. Slightly nasal, sceptical and tired, drawn-out dismissive tone, unimpressed, mid-pitched.
test: Bruv, I was in Year Four when Five dropped. Allow it.
Man ain't left his yard in five days. His mum rang me, fam.

fast.ref_en: Yo yo yo! Wagwan, fam! You lot will not believe what just happened, bruv! This is mad, listen, listen!
fast.design: A young Black British teenager from South London, about 18, with a strong Multicultural London English roadman accent. Very loud, fast and hyped, high energy, excited, voice rising and almost cracking, talks quickly, playful.
test: Wagwan! GTA Six is finally out, fam! Thirteen years, bruv!
